nodes.label: Strategy tournament (9 paths scored across 5 adversarial lenses)
nodes.rationale: Each strategy scored 1-10 as the mean across Market, Moat, Execution, Financials and Regulatory red-team lenses.

nodes.label: #1 lazybull Pro: prosumer-saas workbench (score 5)
nodes.rationale: OptionStrat + TradingView for traders who don't yet 'get it': visual learn-by-doing workbench with an AI teacher, freemium-to-Pro subscription.

nodes.label: #2 Lazybull Academy: creator-empire (score 5)
nodes.rationale: Creator-led interactive options curriculum + paid cohort/community for the 91% who lose money.

nodes.label: #3 Margin: ai-copilot (score 5)
nodes.rationale: Conversational AI options copilot that grades paper trades and builds strategies from a sentence, paid monthly.

nodes.label: #4 The 91% Club: india-fno (score 5)
nodes.rationale: India's first SEBI-aligned paper-only F&O simulator; highest Market & Demand score (7) of all nine strategies.

nodes.label: #5 LazyBull Arena: prop-sim (score 4.8, killed)
nodes.rationale: Paid skill-assessment league; killed because pay-to-fail retake economics are the exact predatory pattern SEBI and the FTC target.

nodes.label: #6 lazybull Quant Pro: data-signals (score 4.7, reframed)
nodes.rationale: High-ARPU analytics/signals terminal; killed as wedge because the product has no real IV feed — you cannot charge a flow trader $59 for synthetic IV.

nodes.label: #7 Lazybull Engine: api-b2b2c (score 4.6, grafted)
nodes.rationale: Embeddable widgets + metered API + white-label; too thin as primary for a 3-person team (6-8 buyers, 9-month cycles), best idea grafted into the wedge.

nodes.label: #8 Strava for Options: community-viral (score 4.2, grafted)
nodes.rationale: Social learning game with shareable trade cards; sub-critical k-factor (0.24) kills it as primary, but the share card survives as a free growth object.

nodes.label: #9 Options education layer: acquisition-build (score 4, killed as thesis)
nodes.rationale: Build-to-be-bought front door; killed as stated thesis — market-of-~1 buyer concentration and synthetic admin-funnel 'proof pack' is a diligence landmine.
